entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
I need to make a return.
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could you tell me a bit more about the item? For example, is it a technical fault or a preference issue?
It's a jersey. It doesn't fit.
Okay, a jersey. And what's the specific issue with the fit?
It's the wrong size. It's just too tight.
I understand. Let me just pull up your account to check the return eligibility. What's the order number or email address associated with the purchase?

Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the ProFit Jersey, delivered about 63 days ago. Looking at our policy, you are well within the 90-day return window, so we can definitely process this for you. Would you prefer a full refund, or would you like to do an exchange for a larger size?
A refund. Obviously. I'm not interested in waiting another two months for an exchange.

I understand completely. And I see here you're one of our VIP members. To make this easier, I've gone ahead and processed that full refund for you, and I've also waived the return shipping fee. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to your email now. Just use that to send the jersey back to us at your convenience.
It's on its way. You should see it in your inbox within the next 5 minutes. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
